in_marathi.name: Deeptish
in_marathi.long_meaning: Deeptish हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। From the Sanskrit words ‘deep’ and ‘ish’, meaning ‘Deep, Intelligent’. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with the deep wisdom and intelligence of great sages and seers.
